Hi John,

I wanted to give you a quick overview of the NXP i.MX 95 and its Neutron NPU. The i.MX 95 is a powerful applications processor that features advanced graphics and video cores, powerful vision and machine learning acceleration, efficient CPU performance, real-time processing, and advanced security with the integrated EdgeLock® secure enclave to support energy-efficient edge computing. A rich set of peripherals and processor cores support these features.

One of the key features of the i.MX 95 is its Neutron NPU, which is an on-chip hardware accelerator that provides efficient processing of machine-learning workloads. It works in conjunction with the chip's CPU to deliver higher performance and lower power consumption for neural network (NN) inference. In addition to managing Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) compute blocks throughput, NPU also:

- Optimizes arrangement of weights
- Manages memory accesses
- Provides rescaling, activation, and pooling functions

Enablement support for the eIQ® Neutron N3-1024S NPU is provided with the eIQ Toolkit and eIQ Machine Learning (ML) Software Development Environment. Some of the features and operators listed in this chapter may not be enabled in eIQ software. See References for links to eIQ documentation that lists the features and operators enabled in the latest eIQ software.

You can import your trained and quantized NN into eIQ Toolkit. The eIQ tooling generates an NPU-optimized model that can be integrated into an ML application running on the target device.

**NXP i.MX 95 Applications Processor**

**Overview**

The NXP i.MX 95 is a high-performance, secure, and energy-efficient applications processor designed for industrial and IoT applications. It features a dual-core Arm Cortex-A55 and a single-core Arm Cortex-M7, providing a powerful combination for complex tasks. The processor includes a dedicated eIQ Neutron N3-1024S NPU, which accelerates machine learning workloads, and supports advanced security features like the EdgeLock Secure Enclave.

**NPU**

The eIQ Neutron N3-1024S NPU is a hardware accelerator that provides efficient processing of machine-learning workloads. It works in conjunction with the chip's CPU to deliver higher performance and lower power consumption for neural network (NN) inference. The NPU is designed to optimize the arrangement of weights, manage memory accesses, and provide rescaling, activation, and pooling functions. The NPU is an on-chip hardware accelerator that provides efficient processing of machine-learning workloads. It works in conjunction with the chip's CPU to deliver higher performance and lower power consumption for neural network (NN) inference. In addition to managing Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) compute blocks throughput, NPU also: • Optimizes arrangement of weights • Manages memory accesses • Provides rescaling, activation, and pooling functions

**Memory/Connectivity**

The i.MX 95 supports LPDDR5/LPDDR4X memory, providing a high-speed, low-power solution for memory-intensive applications. The processor includes a wide range of interfaces, including MIPI DSI, LVDS, UARTs, SPI, QSPI, I²C, and SDIO. The i.MX 95 also supports USB 3.0, USB 2.0, 10/100/1000 Ethernet, and 2x PCIe Gen 3.0 x12. The processor supports up to 10 GbE (w/TSN) and 2x PCIe® Gen 3.0 x12.
